about.text: A firm, aged Mexican cheese traditionally made from skimmed goat's milk but most often available made from skimmed cow's milk. After it is made it is rolled in paprika to add additional flavor to its salty sharp flavor.

sources.text: Rolled in paprika; salty, crumbly, grating; ripening not verified
Rolled in paprika; salty, crumbly, grating; ripening not verified

facts.v: Sometimes coated in chili (enchilado) rather than paprika
The aged version of queso fresco
